calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH first_v AS (
  SELECT member_id, min(join_date) AS jmin, max(join_date) AS jmax, count(*) AS versions, min(valid_from) AS first_valid
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 sum(CASE WHEN jmin <> jmax THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN jmin = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_0925,
 sum(CASE WHEN first_valid = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_valid_0925,
 sum(CASE WHEN jmin = DATE '2026-09-25' AND first_valid <> jmin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN jmin = DATE '2026-09-25' AND versions > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_version
FROM first_v
